name: a4_screen_b2
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,dev; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; if [ -n "${G_URI:-}" ] && [ ! -f babylm/runs/a4_G/result.json ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_G; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$G_URI" babylm/runs/a4_G; fi; python -m babylm.a4.data halves

jobs.name: a4_generate_b2
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_data/gen; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_A.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_GA/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_A --selfseed --words 9953773; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_B.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_GB/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_B --selfseed --words 9953773

jobs.name: a4_build_b2
jobs.cmd: [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n1b/bin/synth.meta.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.data build babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n1b babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_A.jsonl.gz babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/n1b_B.jsonl.gz --words 19907546; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n2b/bin/synth.meta.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.data shuffle babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_a4b babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n2b

jobs.name: a4_audit_b2
jobs.cmd: [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/audit/leak_b2.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit leak babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n1b babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n2b --eval_dir /opt/babylm/osf/evaluation_data --out babylm/runs/a4_data/audit/leak_b2.json; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_data/audit/copy_n1b.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit copy babylm/runs/a4_data/syn_n1b --probe babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/probe.jsonl.gz --out babylm/runs/a4_data/audit/copy_n1b.json

jobs.name: a4_n1b
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a4_screen.json --only a4_n1b --device cuda; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_n1b/result.json ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_n1b/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_n1b /opt/babylm; }

jobs.name: a4_n2b
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a4_screen.json --only a4_n2b --device cuda; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_n2b/result.json ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_n2b/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_n2b /opt/babylm; }

jobs.name: a4_report
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_data/plots; for r in a4_G a4_GA a4_GB a4_n0a a4_a a4_n1a a4_n2a a4_n0b a4_b a4_n1b a4_n2b; do [ -f babylm/runs/$r/curves.csv ] && python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/$r; done; python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/a4_G babylm/runs/a4_n0a babylm/runs/a4_a babylm/runs/a4_n1a babylm/runs/a4_n2a --out babylm/runs/a4_data/plots/arm_a; python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/a4_G babylm/runs/a4_n0b babylm/runs/a4_b babylm/runs/a4_n1b babylm/runs/a4_n2b --out babylm/runs/a4_data/plots/arm_b; python -m babylm.a4.ledger babylm/runs/a4_n0a babylm/runs/a4_a babylm/runs/a4_n1a babylm/runs/a4_n2a babylm/runs/a4_n0b babylm/runs/a4_b babylm/runs/a4_n1b babylm/runs/a4_n2b --base_epochs 10 --out babylm/runs/a4_data/ledger.json

note: Batch 2, only if A4b has the lower full-DEV nats/word: set RESTORE_URI to batch 1's <bucket>/vms/<VM>/out/babylm/runs. A4 screen (base job base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied from ref-0065:babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json). Plan {'E_star': 10, 'E_G': 4, 'E_g': 2, 'R_a': 3, 'R_b': 2, 'syn_words_a': 29861319, 'syn_words_b': 19907546, 'words_a': 99537730, 'words_b': 99537730}. One A100, sequential, about 2 h (batch 2 about 45 min): maxdur 3 h (batch 2: 1.5 h). Preempted => relaunch the same file with env RESTORE_URI=<bucket>/vms/<old VM>/out/babylm/runs (every step skips what exists). Afterwards copy each run's small files (result.json, config.json, curves.csv, train_log.csv, *.png, score/*.json) and babylm/runs/a4_data/{audit,plots,ledger.*} and babylm/runs/a4_data/gen/*.json to shared/babylm/attacks/A4/<run>/; tell the A4 thread (it reports the audits first, then the screen).
